## OpenRamble 0.34.1

**Dictation starts faster after your Mac has been busy.**

When macOS had moved OpenRamble out of memory, the first press of the dictation key started the microphone late. The app now keeps the microphone set up between dictations, so a press only has to start it.

With memory full and every core busy, the microphone now starts in 87 ms instead of 136 ms at the median, and in at most 148 ms instead of 315 ms.

The microphone still does not run between dictations.
